name: Profile Page Extension
description: Profile page frontend extensions such as About Me tabs, user.bio display, and static profile information sections using existing data.

verificationSteps: Confirm whether the request wants a new tab or a new static section.
Confirm whether the content comes from an existing field or requires a new field.
Verify Profile route, Profile component, and existing tab structure before patching.

blockingQuestions: Should the profile extension be a new tab or a static section?
Does the displayed content come from an existing field such as user.bio, or does it require a new field?
safeDefaults: If user.bio is already present in frontend profile data, render it as read-only text.
If tab placement is unspecified and an existing tab structure exists, add an About Me tab next to existing profile tabs.
If no tab structure exists, add a static section only after confirmation.
confirmationDefaults: Route new fields to add-entity-field instead of modifying backend in this Skill.

allowedChanges: Verified ProfilePage frontend files under TARGET_REPO_PATH
Verified profile-related frontend components under TARGET_REPO_PATH
forbiddenChanges: Backend model, route, serializer, or database changes
successCriteria: The profile UI extension uses existing frontend data or routes to add-entity-field.
The change does not modify Follow, Favorite, like, backend, database, or API behavior.
The affected Profile page surface is verified before patching.
Frontend validation plan is produced from discovered scripts.
